output.summary: A genus of flowering trees and tall shrubs native to South America, from Peru and northeastern Brazil southward. Commonly called pepper trees, some species have become invasive beyond their natural habitats, and one member, Schinus molle, supplies pink peppercorn.
output.edibilityNote: Only Schinus molle is identified as a pink-peppercorn source; human food use is not established for the genus as a whole.
